sections.heading: Shape Removeoperator
sections.content:
The Shape Remove operator allows you to remove assigned meshes (or parts of assigned meshes) from particles.

Mode: controls whether entire shape meshes will be removed, or just parts of them.

sections.heading: MatIDs
sections.content:
MatIDs: faces with material IDs matching those listed here will be removed.Invert: when enabled, faces with material IDs not matching those listed will be removed instead.

MatIDs: faces with material IDs matching those listed here will be removed.

Invert: when enabled, faces with material IDs not matching those listed will be removed instead.
